chunks: 4093 - A man said to al-Sadiq عليه السلام: “Indeed, I entrusted a man with some wealth, depositing it with him, but he betrayed me regarding it and denied my property.”
So he عليه السلام said: “The trustworthy one did not betray you; rather, you entrusted a traitor.”

key_terms.أَوْدَعْتُهُ: I deposited it; I placed it as a deposit
key_terms.ائْتَمَنْتُ: I entrusted; I placed something in another person’s care
key_terms.الْأَمِينُ: the trustworthy person, one worthy of trust
key_terms.الْخَائِنَ: the traitor, one who betrays trust
key_terms.فَخَانَنِي: he betrayed me; he acted treacherously toward me

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام say about entrusting wealth to someone who betrays it?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches a concise moral lesson about trust and discernment in dealing with others. It shifts attention from the abstract idea of entrusted property to the character of the person chosen, emphasizing responsibility in whom one trusts.
